js101.name: Intro to JavaScript
js101.desc: Master the core building blocks of JavaScript with hands-on lessons. This course lays a strong foundation for writing logic, organizing data, and creating structured, interactive code—perfect for aspiring developers taking their first steps into programming.

sections.title: Basic Concepts
sections.desc: This unit goes over basic concepts of javascript, including variables, constants, number operations, string concatination, and logging to the console.
